name: Vercel
description: Vercel deployment platform integration. Manage deployments, check build status, access logs, configure domains, and control your frontend infrastructure directly from Claude Code.
longDescription:
Ships **33 skills**, **3 agents**, **5 commands**, **2 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (33): `access-protected-vercel-deployment` (Access and test Vercel deployments protected by Vercel Authentication, SSO, or Deployment Protection), `ai-gateway` (Vercel AI Gateway expert guidance), `ai-sdk` (Vercel AI SDK expert guidance), `auth` (Authentication integration guidance — Clerk (native Vercel Marketplace), Descope, and Auth0 setup for Next.js applications), `bootstrap` (Project bootstrapping orchestrator for repos that depend on Vercel-linked resources (databases, auth, and managed integrations)), `build-agents` (Default guidance for building AI agents), `cdn-caching` (Debug Vercel CDN caching — cache hit rate, stale content, revalidation behavior, ISR + PPR, per-request cache reasons…), `chat-sdk` (Vercel Chat SDK expert guidance), and 25 more
- **Agents** (3): `ai-architect` (Specializes in architecting AI-powered applications on Vercel — choosing between AI SDK patterns, configuring providers, building agents, setting…), `deployment-expert` (Specializes in Vercel deployment strategies, CI/CD pipelines, preview URLs, production promotions, rollbacks, environment variables, and domain configuration), `performance-optimizer` (Specializes in optimizing Vercel application performance — Core Web Vitals, rendering strategies, caching, image optimization, font loading, edge…)
- **Commands** (5): `_conventions`, `bootstrap` (Bootstrap a repository with Vercel-linked resources by running preflight checks, provisioning integrations, verifying env keys, and then executing…), `deploy` (Deploy the current project to Vercel), `env` (Manage Vercel environment variables), `status` (Show the status of the current Vercel project — recent deployments, linked project info, and environment overview)
- **Hooks** (2): `SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`
- **MCP servers** (1): `vercel`

Installs with `claude plugin install vercel@claude-plugins-official` from `vercel/vercel-plugin`.
